purpose: Provide one machine-readable source for the public criminal-law/evidence architecture without converting allegations, institutional receipt, legal error, relationship, chronology or benefit into findings of criminal liability.

controlling_attributed_theory.es: Gil Marer y Aweswell alegan una sola empresa continuada de criminalidad económica, desarrollada mediante adopción sucesiva y división de funciones.
controlling_attributed_theory.en: Gil Marer and Aweswell allege one continuing economic-criminal enterprise, advanced through successive adoption and divided functions.
does_not_itself_prove: a statutory criminal organisation under Criminal Code Article 570 bis
a statutory criminal group under Criminal Code Article 570 ter
does_not_change: whether any specific offence is continuing or permanent

rdm_manifest_phase_a.source_class: PRIVATE MANIFEST OR INDEX; NOT NATIVE EMAIL, ATTACHMENT OR DRIVE CORPUS
rdm_manifest_phase_a.support_gate: Acquire, preserve and authenticate native emails, attachments and Drive originals or versions; link them to actors and acts; then test supporting, contrary and exculpatory material.
rdm_manifest_phase_a.open_native_status: NOT YET TESTABLE FROM THE MANIFEST
rdm_manifest_phase_a.open_native_status_scope: This describes the manifest/native contribution only; the overall proposition is assessed separately from all controlled evidence.
rdm_manifest_phase_a.privacy: No private addresses, queries, provider identifiers, message content, exact private matrices or live strategy are public.

legal_element_controls.article_11: Omission requires a result offence, a specific legal or contractual duty or prior creation of risk, real capacity to prevent, equivalence to causing the result and counterfactual causal contribution.
legal_element_controls.articles_28_29: Later conduct does not retroactively create authorship or participation in an already completed offence; post-offence liability routes must be tested separately.
legal_element_controls.articles_446_449: Separate a knowingly unjust decision, a manifestly unjust decision through gross negligence or inexcusable ignorance, refusal to adjudicate, and delay deliberately caused for an illegitimate purpose. Identify the competent actor, do not add a causal-result element to Article 449, and keep induced judicial error distinct.
legal_element_controls.articles_570bis_570ter: Article 570 bis stability and coordinated task division are not Article 570 ter requirements. Organisation and residual group are separate statutory alternatives; the factual enterprise thesis does not establish either.

red_sara_snapshot.source: REG/REG-AGE CSV snapshot supplied for analysis; source file preserved separately
red_sara_snapshot.caveat: REG exchange status proves only the registration/exchange state shown by the source. It does not by itself establish substantive receipt by the competent unit, joinder, admission, investigation, acceptance, endorsement or truth of the underlying proposition.

adverse_evidence_rule.example: AP 804/2018 is materially adverse: it confirmed provisional dismissal, treated much of the dispute as civil, questioned the criminally protectable possession asserted for CEXP and relied on the insolvency administrator's account. It must be disclosed accurately together with the matters it did not adjudicate.

publication_rule: Do not intensify attribution merely because multiple documents, actors or institutions form a chronology. Public criminal framing must remain actor-specific, source-specific, falsifiable and correction-first.
